Человек ростом 1,80 м поднимается на две: A person 1.80 m tall climbs two stairs 17 cm high each, bringing the second foot up to the first on each stair, and then goes back down. The simplest transfer takes the joint angles as is and multiplies the path of the pelvis by the ratio of leg lengths, 0.65 / 0.96. That's how DeepMimic transferred recordings to a model of the Atlas robot, and how ExBody transfers them to the H1 robot. The stairs in Ada's home are the same, 17 cm each.

Перенести подъём копированием углов: Transfer the climb by copying angles

Стопа Ады уходит во вторую ступеньку до: Ada's foot sinks into the second stair by up to ${fmt(r.pen, 1)} cm. Her joint angles are human, but her leg is shorter: 0.65 m versus 0.96 m. So each step lifts Ada in the same proportion, 0.68 of the person's rise: for a 17 cm stair, only ${fmt(E.STEP.H * 100 * E.legLen(E.ADA) / E.legLen(E.HUMAN), 1)} cm, and the shortfall grows with every stair. The world doesn't shrink along with Ada: her floor and stairs are the same as the person's. Copying angles works as long as there's one flat support, but on stairs, the feet have to go where the support actually is.

Ada's feet go where the person's feet are: on the floor and on the same stairs. The pelvis stays above the same spot as the person's, and its height above the support is scaled to Ada's leg. The hip and knee angles come from the leg's inverse kinematics from lesson 0.3.

The person, meanwhile, bends the hip up to ${fmt(r.humanHip, 0)}°. A 17 cm stair is 18% of the person's leg length and 26% of Ada's, so she has to lift her knee higher to carry her foot over the edge. Keypoints fixed the proportions but asked more of the joints than they can give.
Третий способ берёт те же ключевые точки: The third method takes the same keypoints but keeps the hip within its limit. If the hip lacks angle, the torso leans less by the missing amount, so the direction of the thigh and the position of the feet don't change. The other joints are clipped to their limits, and the pelvis is placed on the support. The climb is slow, so Ada stays up only if her center of mass is over her feet the whole time. On the scene, a circle marks the center of mass, and segments under the feet mark the support.

Запись — ходьба человека, перенесённая н: The recording is human walking transferred to Ada with the third method from Lab 1. The reward works as in DeepMimic: closeness of the joint angles and velocities and of the foot and pelvis positions to the frame of the recording at the same phase, plus a reward for following the velocity command. The phase runs on the recording's clock and is fed to the policy. An episode starts from a random frame of the recording, and a fall ends it. The reward for the pelvis and foot positions is computed in world coordinates, so it pulls Ada toward the recording both in place and in time.
Обучить ту же политику с дискриминатором: Train the same policy with a discriminator
Параметры политики и запись те же, а наг: The policy parameters and the recording are the same, but the reward is different. A discriminator learns to tell transitions between neighboring frames of the recording from Ada's transitions, and the policy gets more the closer the discriminator's score is to “recording.” The policy has no recording clock: it picks its stepping frequency itself, starting at 1 Hz, and can change it with the command. The reward for following the velocity command is the same as the tracker's.

Награда DeepMimic считает близость к зап: DeepMimic's reward measures closeness to the recording. So does the policy play back the recording's frames, like an animation?
Да: это кинематическое воспроизведение з: Yes: it's a kinematic playback of the recording
Нет: политика выдаёт целевые углы ПД-рег: No: the policy outputs target angles to PD controllers, and the motion comes out of a physics simulation, so it has balance and responds to pushes
Запись задаёт, к чему стремиться, а силы: The recording says what to aim for, and the simulator computes the forces. That's why DeepMimic's walking policy withstood pushes that weren't in the recording, and in Lab 2 the tracker kept its balance without a separate “don't fall” term.
Зачем DeepMimic начинает каждый эпизод и: Why does DeepMimic start each episode from a random frame of the recording?
Чтобы данных для дискриминатора было бол: To have more data for the discriminator
Чтобы политика с первых эпизодов видела: So that the policy sees the late phases of the motion from the very first episodes and doesn't have to learn it strictly in order
Без старта из записи персонаж DeepMimic: Without RSI, DeepMimic's character learned a small hop instead of a backflip: it simply never reached the good states at the end of the jump. In our table, without RSI Ada learned even walking worse, and for ExBody, training without it didn't work at all.
Ранний останов при падении нужен только: Is early termination on a fall only there to save simulation time?
Нет: после падения награда до конца эпиз: No: after a fall, the reward for the rest of the episode is zero, so falling doesn't pay, and lying-down states don't pile up in the experience
Нет: без него обучение невозможно в прин: No: without it, training is impossible in principle
Авторы DeepMimic пишут, что без раннего: The DeepMimic authors write that without early termination, early experience is dominated by the character “struggling on the ground in vain.” For walking, termination barely changes the result, in our table too, but for a backflip it's decisive.
Дискриминатор AMP сравнивает позу Ады с: Does AMP's discriminator compare Ada's pose with the right frame of the recording?
Да, с кадром в той же фазе: Yes, with the frame at the same phase
Нет: он оценивает переход между двумя со: No: it scores a transition between two neighboring states, that is, whether it looks like the transitions in the recordings; there's no phase and no choice of recording
Да, с ближайшим по времени кадром: Yes, with the frame closest in time
Поэтому у политики AMP в лаборатории 2 с: That's why the AMP policy in Lab 2 has its own stepping rhythm while its gait stays similar to the recorded one. For the same reason, AMP can be given a dataset of dozens of unlabeled recordings: there's no need to decide which recording to follow.
Трекинг записи на ходьбе точнее AMP. Зна: Motion tracking is more accurate than AMP on walking. So is AMP worse?
Нет: трекинг точнее, потому что фаза при: No: tracking is more accurate because the phase ties it to the recording, while AMP pays in accuracy for the freedom to change tempo and use many recordings
Нет: AMP точнее на всех движениях: No: AMP is more accurate on all motions
В лаборатории 2 политика AMP шагала чаще: In Lab 2, the AMP policy stepped more often at a higher command and outpaced the tracker at 1.25 times the recording's speed, while the tracker kept the recording's tempo. In the AMP paper, tracking is more accurate on walking and running, and AMP is more accurate on the spin and the sideflip.
Скопировать углы суставов человека на ро: Is copying a human's joint angles onto a robot always a bad way to retarget?
Да: нужна подгонка ключевых точек: Yes: you need to fit keypoints
Нет: на ровном полу при похожих пропорци: No: on a flat floor with similar leg proportions, it works; it stops working when the motion relies on objects that don't shrink along with the robot, or asks more of the joints than they can give
Так DeepMimic переносил записи на Atlas,: That's how DeepMimic transferred recordings to Atlas and ExBody to H1. In Lab 1, copying angles failed on the stairs: the steps shrank along with Ada, while the stairs stayed the same. H2O fits the shape of the human model to the robot: without that, H1 got an in-toed gait.
После ретаргетинга суставы в пределах, а: After retargeting, the joints are within their limits and the feet are on the floor. So will the robot be able to perform the recording?
Да: всё, что возможно кинематически, вып: Yes: anything that's kinematically possible is feasible
Нет: кинематика не проверяет равновесие: No: kinematics doesn't check balance or torques, and the center of mass can leave the support; only physics checks that
Да, если запись медленная: Yes, if the recording is slow
В лаборатории 1 третий способ соблюдал п: In Lab 1, the third method respected the limits and the floor, and Ada stayed up on the stairs, but in the squat, the center of mass moved past the heels: the hip was 39° short, and the torso had to straighten by as much. That's why H2O runs all retargeted recordings through a tracker in simulation and throws out the ones it can't perform.
Если усреднить две записи ходьбы, начаты: If you average two walking recordings started with different legs, will a tracker on the mean learn the same walking?
Нет: среднее — это ноги вместе при движу: No: the mean is legs together with a moving pelvis; the tracker steps anyway but doesn't get close to the recording, and the imitation reward stays low
Да, если добавить фазу: Yes, if you add a phase
Это та же мультимодальность, что объезд: This is the same multimodality as driving around the kettle on either side in lesson 1.3. DeepMimic takes the max of the reward over recordings or gives the policy the recording's number as input, while AMP looks at transitions and doesn't need the recording's number.
